keyEvents.text: Nico Paz (Como) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Como).
Delay in match (AEK Athens).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Penalty missed. Lucas da Cunha (Como) left footed shot is close, but misses to the left.
Second Half begins Como 0, AEK Athens 0.
Yan Couto (Como) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Como 1, AEK Athens 0. Luis Milla (Como) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Martin Baturina.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Barnabás Varga replaces Dereck Kutesa.
Lovro Majer (AEK Athens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Como. Ivan Smolcic replaces Yan Couto.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Zine replaces Luka Jovic.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Petros Mantalos replaces Mijat Gacinovic.
Delay in match because of an injury Jacobo Ramón (Como).
Razvan Marin (AEK Athens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Stavros Pilios (AEK Athens) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, AEK Athens. Kaan Kairinen replaces Lovro Majer.
Substitution, AEK Athens. João Mário replaces Milán Vitális.
Substitution, Como. Kaiki replaces Martin Baturina.
Substitution, Como. Marc Oliver Kempf replaces Trevoh Chalobah.
Substitution, Como. Samuele Ricci replaces Lucas da Cunha.
